text: On July 19, 2022, the City received Official Plan and Zoning By-law Amendment applications for 25 Old York Mills Road (the "Site") to permit the construction of a 12-storey (38.05 metres, plus 4.5 metres for the mechanical penthouse) mixed-use building. The applicant appealed City Council's neglect or failure to make a decision on its applications for the Official Plan and Zoning By-law Amendment (the "Appeal"), to the Ontario Land Tribunal on January 6, 2023. Two Case Management Conferences have taken place, and a hearing was scheduled to commence on November 15, 2023. The Toronto Region Conservation Authority and two residents associations, the Townhomes of Hogg's Hollow Community Association and the York Mills Valley Association, were granted party status, and two individuals obtained participant status. City Council on October 11 and 12, 2023, deferred Item CC11.11 to the November 8, 9, and 10, 2023 meeting of City Council to provide more time for discussions between the residents and the appellant.
